rubrics.justification: Describes a full/low-expanded blastocyst with loosely grouped ICM and sparse TE consistent with the provided 2BB/BB characterization; minor uncertainty around calling it closer to 3BB and some image-specific features may be inferred from a static view.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, tubal factor, prior IVF outcomes, semen parameters, endometrium, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and structured, with probability estimates tied to embryo quality and patient factors; only minor tension from discussing 2BB versus 3BB nomenclature and a somewhat broad implantation range.

Recommendations are well aligned with standard IVF practice: SET at age 31, attention to hydrosalpinx, cautious use of add-ons, individualized PGT-A discussion, and consideration of freeze-all when endometrial receptivity may be affected.

Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, including hydrosalpinx review, uterine cavity assessment, embryology review, luteal support, and when to consider FET or further workup.
